subject: prd/docgate
statement: When a semantically identical rebase checkpoint is newly added, `check-projection-congruence` shall evaluate the checkpoint as its own boundary and permit lineage compaction only when the checkpoint re-anchors the human-visible ID annotation and the source-map origin to that checkpoint consistently, introducing no after-only mismatch under FR-34.
rationale: ignoring checkpoints lets the named repair create fresh hidden debt; comparing them without defining compaction false-rejects a valid rebase
fit_criterion: a checkpoint containing both a historically annotated row and a grandfathered lineage-less row passes `verify-rebase` and congruence only when both faces re-anchor consistently; retaining old visible lineage with new machine origin and the inverse are red
